column2: [intro]
It's the story of a boy with no tune
He always sings off-key, gives him a swoon
He dreams of being a star, shining on stage
But his lack of tune makes the hyenas engage
What's your tune, tell me my friend?
The tune of life, or the tune of the end?
What's your tune, the one that drives you?
Tell me which tune has made you lose the view?
He meets a singer with a funny tone
She says, "My friend, don't be so alone
The secret is to sing with boldness
Even if your tune lacks the rightness."
What's your tune, tell me my friend?
The tune of laughter, or worries that blend?
What's your tune, the one that sets you apart?
Tell me which tune makes you so smart?
[ solo ]
What's your tune, tell me my friend?
The tune of success, or desires that send?
What's your tune, the one that transcends?
Tell me which tune within you extends?
[outro]
